_comment: Claude for Microsoft 365 add-on (claude-m365). Microsoft Graph delegated scopes on the 'M365 MCP Server for Claude' app, grouped into what Claude can read (readAreas) and what it can change (levels). Scope lists follow Anthropic's Microsoft 365 connector docs: https://claude.com/docs/third-party/claude-desktop/connectors-m365 and https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12684923.

readAreas.label: Email
readAreas.description: Search and read email, including shared mailboxes the person can open.

readAreas.label: Calendar
readAreas.description: Read calendars and find meeting times.

readAreas.label: OneDrive and SharePoint files
readAreas.description: Search and read files and SharePoint sites the person can open.

readAreas.label: Teams chats and channels
readAreas.description: Read Teams chats and channel messages the person can see.

readAreas.label: Teams meetings
readAreas.description: Read online meetings, transcripts, recordings and meeting notes.

levels.summary: Search and read their email, calendar, files and Teams. Can't change anything.
levels.name: Read only
canDo: Search and read the person's email, calendar, OneDrive and SharePoint files, and Teams chats and meetings
Summarise, find information and answer questions about it
cannotDo: Send, change, move or delete anything in Microsoft 365
pros: Lowest risk: nothing in Microsoft 365 can be changed
Ideal for research, catching up on long threads and finding documents
A safe way to start and learn what Claude is useful for
cons: You copy Claude's suggested replies into Outlook yourself
Claude can see everything the person can see, including sensitive mail and files
Something Claude reads, such as a malicious email, could try to influence its answers

levels.summary: Also writes drafts, and moves, labels and deletes email in their own mailbox.
levels.name: Drafts and tidy-up
canDo: Write draft emails into the person's Drafts folder
Move, label and delete email in the person's own mailbox, for example clearing junk
cannotDo: Change shared mailboxes, calendars, files or Teams
pros: Saves typing: replies are ready and waiting in Drafts
Nothing leaves the business without the person reviewing it and pressing Send
cons: Claude can move or delete email. Deleted email can be recovered for a limited time, but mistakes are possible
Only the person's own mailbox: Claude can read shared mailboxes but can't tidy them
levels.suits: Most people once they are comfortable with Level 1

levels.summary: Also sends and forwards email, manages meetings, out-of-office and mail rules.
levels.name: Personal assistant
levels.tagline: Claude acts on the person's behalf
canDo: Send and forward email as the person
Set out-of-office replies and mail rules
pros: Real time savings: Claude can finish a task, not just prepare it
In the Claude desktop app, Claude always asks the person to approve each email or invite before it is sent
cons: Email and invites go out in the person's name
A malicious email could try to trick Claude into forwarding information out of the business
Mail rules could redirect email if misused
Relies on the person reading each approval carefully
levels.suits: Experienced users who handle a lot of email and diary management

levels.summary: Also changes OneDrive and SharePoint files, and posts in Teams.
levels.name: Full access
canDo: Create, edit, move and delete files in OneDrive and SharePoint that the person can edit
Post in Teams chats and channels, and start new chats
pros: The most automation: Claude can carry out whole tasks across Microsoft 365
No need to switch between Claude and other apps
cons: Highest risk: Claude could change or delete company files the person can edit
Messages in Teams go out in the person's name
A mistake or a manipulated instruction affects shared company data, not just one inbox
We only recommend this with a tested third-party backup in place, and for a small number of people
levels.suits: A few named people, with a third-party backup in place
